x-summary: A phone number, email address, radio callsign or unit address.
title: ContactInfo
description: Communications-directory-flavored (not STANAG 5046-conformant — ; that standard's exact field structure isn't verified here) contact record for a person. `use` is a genuinely verified addition: unlike most of this project's FHIR-flavored fields, FHIR's ContactPoint.system/.use ARE plain closed enums actually encoded in the vendored priv/fhir/R5/fhir.schema.json (ContactPoint isn't a generic CodeableConcept the way Condition.clinicalStatus etc. are) — confirmed by reading that file directly, not from memory.

contactType.description: Kept as originally defined — a mix of FHIR's ContactPoint.system values (phone/email/other) and this domain's own additions (radio_callsign/unit_address) that have no FHIR equivalent. NOT redefined to match ContactPoint.system exactly (that real enum is phone/fax/pager/url/sms/email/other) to avoid a breaking rename of existing data; `use` below is the additive way to get closer to FHIR's actual shape without that.

use.x-help: What the contact is for: home, work, mobile, temporary, or no longer in use.
use.description: FHIR ContactPoint.use — verified directly against priv/fhir/R5/fhir.schema.json (a real closed enum in that file, not a generic CodeableConcept). Complements contactType rather than replacing it: e.g. contactType="phone" + use="mobile" is more precise than contactType alone ever was.

unit.description: Organization/unit this contact is associated with, free text.
